Why BestBaggs

Five reasons procurement teams
keep coming back.

Capabilities that matter on the spec sheet — not just the pitch deck. Built for buyers who move volume and can't afford a supplier mistake.

01

Custom Printing & Branding. Your spec, exactly.

Up to 8-colour flexographic printing on BOPP, PP woven and laminated surfaces. Pantone matching, bleed-to-edge layouts, and logo registration held to ±0.5 mm. Artwork handoff to press-ready film: 5–7 working days.

Flexo · 8-Colour · Pantone
02

BIS & ISO Compliance. Documented. Auditable.

Bags manufactured to BIS IS 11652 / IS 9755 standards. ISO 9001-aligned process controls with full batch traceability. Every shipment includes mill test certificates, GSM reports and seam-strength data — ready for your quality audit.

BIS · ISO 9001 · Batch Certs
03

Export-Ready Packaging. 16+ countries. Zero customs surprises.

Shipments cleared from JNPT, Mundra and Chennai. Pre-shipment inspection on request. Phytosanitary certificates, fumigation records and country-of-origin documentation prepared as standard for agricultural commodity packaging.

JNPT · Mundra · Pre-ship Inspection
04

Flexible MOQs. Small pilot or full container — both work.

Domestic orders from 5,000 units. Export LCL consolidation from 10,000 units. FCL (20'/40') pricing available from 50,000 units with volume-tiered rates. No minimum-order penalty for repeat SKUs on the same print plate.

MOQ 5K · LCL · FCL Rates
05

In-House Quality Lab. We test it before you receive it.

On-site lab runs tensile strength, elongation at break, GSM, UV stability and drop-impact tests on every production run. Rejection rate held below 0.4%. Full QC report attached to every dispatch note — no third-party delays.

Tensile · GSM · UV · Drop Test

Steps

From Enquiry to Delivery.
No Ambiguity.

Four stages. Clear checkpoints. Every procurement run follows the same disciplined sequence.

01
Day 1–2
01 / Enquiry & Specs

Tell us exactly what you need.

Submit bag type, dimensions, GSM, print requirement and target quantity. We confirm specs and feasibility within 24 hours.

02
Day 5–12
02 / Sampling & Approval

Physical samples before a single unit runs.

Pre-production samples dispatched for your quality sign-off. Amendments logged and corrected before production order is locked.

03
Day 13–28
03 / Production & QC

Manufacturing under documented inspection.

In-line QC checks at extrusion, weaving, lamination and printing stages. Batch reports available on request.

04

Packed, documented, shipped on schedule.

Full export documentation — commercial invoice, packing list, BL, COO — handled for international consignments. Domestic dispatches tracked door-to-door.
